svg.title: Observables legality, accepted-step sampling, support-scoped volume reductions, and provenance
svg.desc: Four-stage observables pipeline: (a) accepted-step sampling discarding rejected adaptive RK trials; (b) fail-closed planner legality gate validate_executable_outputs rejecting missing prerequisites or unsupported lanes without silent zeros; (c) native FDM/FEM field support and volume-weighted scalar reductions Q_scalar = sum_{i in Omega_m} w_i q_i excluding FEM airbox elements; (d) provenance-complete Zarr, HDF5, and CSV artifacts.
